description: FitAI Pro is a workout management app built to help users plan and track gym sessions more efficiently. It includes a database of over 5,000 exercises with form notes and set/rep guidance, along with tools for logging weights, reps, and sets during workouts. Users can generate workout plans based on available equipment and monitor their training progress over time.
